equation_summary: Plain softmax attention with a pattern-restricted visible set: scores q·k/sqrt(d) over a dilated sliding band of width 2w+1 per query (mask_invalid_locations; -10000 added outside band and at padding), softmaxed jointly in fp32 with the extra global columns concatenated — non-global query i attends to band(i) ∪ {global tokens} (symmetric attention, or causal-only band when autoregressive=True in the tvm mode). Global token OUTPUTS are overwritten by a separate full attention pass with separate projections query_global/key_global/value_global: global queries attend to the ENTIRE sequence (masked only by padding). Head map is MHA (equal heads).
state_shape: none (full recompute; encoder, no KV cache in this source)
normalization: softmax (fp32), -10000 additive mask; all-masked rows handled by post-softmax masked_fill with key_padding_mask
ledger_verdicts: CONFIRM `E[QKV/global/padding mask] ; U1.S[local ∪ global] ; E[encoder output]`: the mixer is exactly softmax attention restricted to local band ∪ global token set, with separate global projections and padding masks all external E stages (longformer.py:138-217).

CONFIRM 'Global-query semantics and B[indexed_K1_schedule]': global queries use SEPARATE q_global/k_global/v_global projections and full-sequence attention whose output OVERWRITES attn at the global positions (longformer.py:221-251) — this asymmetry (global tokens as keys in every row's softmax, but global rows recomputed with different weights) is exactly the global-query semantics the blocker demands; efficient coverage of the band+global index set needs the indexed-K1 schedule (the source uses diagonaled_mm/sliding_chunks custom ops).

NOTE: two softmax normalizations exist (band∪global rows normalized jointly, longformer.py:187-188; global rows normalized separately, longformer.py:244) — both are still exact U1.S instances with appropriate masks/bias, so the direction is unchanged; the joint normalization constant across band+global columns must be preserved by any descriptor.
axis: A2 locality routing / indexed K1 schedule (B[indexed_K1_schedule])
direction_justification: The mixer equation is exactly U1.S over an indexed source set (local band ∪ global tokens, with the separate global-row pass); the only gap to coverage is the closed indexed-K1 schedule/property, not new reducer semantics.
open_questions: autoregressive=True is only supported in the 'tvm' attention mode (asserted at longformer.py:84-86); sliding_chunks modes are noncausal-only — the mode envelope must be recorded.
Per-layer attention_window/attention_dilation lists and dilation support (tvm only) belong to the route descriptor.
Dropout is applied to attention probabilities (training); padding uses -10000 rather than -inf, a numerical-policy detail for parity.
